title: Route Planner
subtitle: Range check based on your personal consumption curve, with disclosed assumptions and automatic charging-stop planning.

form.capacityHintDerived: Derived from current range and SoC — adjust if needed.
form.capacityHintDefault: Could not be derived from vehicle data — default value, please check.
form.historyHint: Only {count, plural, one {# drive} other {# drives}} in history — base value not yet very reliable.
form.routingDefaultHint: public OSRM demo server — set up your own server via OSRM_URL.

errors.missingDestAddress: Please select a destination from the address search.
errors.socRange: Start SoC must be between 0 and 100.
errors.tempInvalid: Please enter a valid outside temperature.
errors.capacityRange: Battery capacity must be between 5 and 250 kWh.
errors.routingUnreachable: Routing service unreachable (timeout or network error). Please try again later.
errors.routingRateLimited: The public OSRM demo server rejected the request (rate limit). Please try again later or set up your own server via OSRM_URL.
errors.routingBadResponse: Unexpected response from the routing service.
errors.routingNoRoute: No route could be calculated for the start and destination. Please choose different points.

result.lowArrivalHint: The predicted arrival SoC is low — a charging stop is required. DriveChronik automatically plans a suitable fast charger along the route.
result.plannedChargingStops: {count, plural, one {# planned charging stop} other {# planned charging stops}}
result.chargersInCorridor: Fast chargers within the 15 km search corridor
result.chargingReserveNote: Calculated for a 20% destination reserve and at least 10% on arrival at a fast charger.
result.chargingPlanIncompleteTitle: Charging plan could not be completed.
result.chargingPlanIncompleteText: No continuous sequence of suitable fast chargers was found along the selected route.

teslaShare.title: Send route to Tesla
teslaShare.description: Without the Tesla Fleet API: DriveChronik sends individual destinations to the Tesla app and also provides the complete multi-stop route through Google Maps, QR code and Tesla handoff mode.
teslaShare.handoffDescription: The planned destinations are shown in order. DriveChronik uses no more than {max} intermediate or charging points per route handoff.
teslaShare.routeSplitHint: {count} intermediate and charging points exceed the limit of {max} intermediate points per handoff. DriveChronik created {parts} route sections.
teslaShare.qrDescription: Scan the QR code with your phone. The complete planned route will then open in Google Maps.
teslaShare.linkCopied: Sharing is not supported on this device – the link was copied instead.
teslaShare.stopsCopied: Route was copied to the clipboard.
teslaShare.shareFailed: Sharing or copying was not available on this device.
teslaShare.hint: On iPhone or Android, select the Tesla app from the system share menu. When DriveChronik is opened over plain HTTP, the system share dialog may be unavailable depending on the browser; the link is then copied as a fallback.

assumptions.speedAdjustmentDesc: {planned} km/h planned vs. ~{reference} km/h historical → factor {factor}
assumptions.footer: Experimental forecast based on assumptions (driving style, wind, load, tires, and climate control are not accounted for). Plan a reserve.
